page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, requiring external block storage for persistent data.

With dedicated CPU allocation, the instance provides predictable processing performance without resource contention from other tenants. The 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it a resource-dense option for workloads that require a larger memory footprint relative to compute capacity, offering qualitative cost efficiency by avoiding the need to provision excess vCPUs solely to obtain sufficient memory.

This hardware profile is suited for memory-intensive applications that do not demand high CPU core counts. Appropriate workloads include small-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, lightweight enterprise applications, and general-purpose tasks requiring moderate memory capacity.
